name: Las Brisas Taqueria
notes: No restaurant-owned website found (work item lists website: null). The restaurant's own food94.com/foodeist.com listing has no prices (403'd on WebFetch, and description text confirms no priced menu there). DoorDash page for the S Main Ave location states explicitly 'Prices on this menu are set directly by the Merchant.' Cent-endings are varied and messy (.99, .60, .75, .25, .50, .70) rather than a uniform round-multiplier pattern, consistent with real POS pricing rather than a platform markup. COMPLETE: combo plates, tacos, mini tacos, crispy taco, rolled tacos, burritos, tortas, quesadillas, tostadas, sopes, breakfast burritos, breakfast plates, rice, beans, salsa, guacamole, drinks all captured. Extra Tortillas (an add-on, not a dish) was not itemized.
